a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ أَنْ أُجَاهِدَهُمْ فِيكَ مِنْ قَوْمٍ كَذَّبُوا رَسُولَكَ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَخْرَجُوهُ
p: Allāhumma innaka taʿlamu annahu laysa aḥadun aḥabba ilayya an ujāhidahum fīka min qawmin kadhdhabū rasūlaka wa akhrajūh
m: O Allah, You know there is no one I would rather strive against for Your sake than a people who called Your Messenger a liar and drove him out.
